messages:
Devon: quick nsys run on latest dedicated -> one kernel dominates GPU time but occupancy low, sharing top-5 snapshot

Devon: command I used:
```bash
nsys profile -o /tmp/trace --trace=cuda,cudnn --sample=none --duration=60 ./run_infer.sh --batch-size 8
```

Devon: top kernels (by GPU time):
```
matmul_fwd_128x128  38.1%   SM util 27%
layernorm_fwd       12.3%   SM util 58%
kv_lookup           9.8%    SM util 22%  (lots of memld)
softmax_attn        6.4%    SM util 44%
axpy_scaling        5.2%    SM util 35%
```

Asha: nice, is KV caching enabled? That kv_lookup at 9.8% + low occupancy could be memory-bound.

Devon: yes KV cache is on. This workload has long context and many cache hits. Oddly matmul shows low occupancy but huge time.

Marisol: could be small-grid GEMM launching many serial kernels. propose scoring = time * (1 + (1 - occupancy)) to upweight low-occupancy hotspots.

Kai: that score will bump matmul up a lot — which is good. Also consider 'warp_efficiency' from nsys if available.

Asha: also check kernel launch rate & kernel duration distribution. If we have many ~2-3us kernels hitting launch overhead, batching heuristic may be wrong.

Devon: found a perf regression after quantization change on 2026-03-10 (commit 0f3c9a). tokens/sec -7% on same input.

Devon: thinking kernel fusion / tile shape change from quantization lowers occupancy on big matmuls.

Marisol: plan: (1) rerun perfetto to capture timeline + host<->kernel alignment, (2) compute time-occupancy score, (3) try small GEMM tiling tweak + run nvprof with per-kernel metrics.

Devon: perfetto command I'll run:
```bash
python -m perfetto.trace --record -o /tmp/perfetto.pb --duration 45 --target pid_of_server
```

perf-bot: Trace uploaded: https://perf-traces/3612349876 (perfetto pb + nsys .qdrep)

Kai: can someone try quick recompile with TILE_M=128->256 for matmul to see occupancy change?

Asha: assigning @Marisol to run the tiling experiment, @Devon to collect timeline + nvprof metrics.

Marisol: ack, will try today and report numbers. short triage call 30m after traces are in? :calendar: 

Devon: thanks — will drop raw nsys qdrep in the thread once done. :thumbsup:
